car_s1.notes: Self-captured glossy toy car; pre-existing 60-view curation used COLMAP poses. EXIF intrinsics, no checkerboard calibration. Reference is the earlier full-data COLMAP model with refined intrinsics, not ground truth.

fountain_s2.notes: User-supplied 11-view fountain. Approximate input intrinsics; reference is an earlier COLMAP model with refined intrinsics. No GT camera or triangle-model files were supplied.

temple_gt.notes: Middlebury calibrated Temple. Existing relaxed SfM settings were previously tuned using this scene, so this is development evaluation.

timing_scope: End-to-end method process, including model loading/export; excludes environment installation and checkpoint download
